notes.title: Smaal fixes
notes.content:
Added a missing death zone that i might have deleted :)
Disabled joining when the door is opening.

notes.title: Gaaame loop update and stuff
notes.content:
Hoi hoi,

I've adjusted the game loop a bit!

Everything should feel more natural when playing the game, not mindlessly feeding a random door anymore!

Major changes
[list]
[*] Designated spawn room
[*] Different in-between areas
[*] Adjusted the room selection for the generation
[*] Big boom
[/list]

Other stuff
[list]
[*] Aliven't button in the pause screen
[*] No soft-lock when dying while someone opens the door
[*] I Hope i fixed the random lobby crashing bug when someone extracts (if not please post the log.txt in a discussion :( )
[*] Made some changes to every room, made everything a bit cleaner and added some more states
[/list]

Next update will include some more content!

notes.title: Seeeeettings
notes.content:
Hola hola

Added new settings!

[list]
[*] Control stuff with bindable keys and toggle options
[*] Graphic stuff with graphic settings!
[/list]

Also some bug fixes

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the server crashes after delivering an artefact
[*] Dropped items should be fully synced now
[*] Jumpscare artefact wont steal mouse when drawing
[*] Voicechat might be improved? There's still a bug where you can't hear other people, but i couldn't replicate it :(
[/list]

Lastly, I added an error log in the: local files => whimsical artefacts_data => log.txt.

if you notice any bugs, I would be very grateful if you post what happened and the last thing you did in the pinned discussion with the log included.
Especially if you encounter the voice chat bug or if you are not able to join a lobby, I have no clue how they are triggered :(


The next update will be a bigger one that changes the game flow quite a bit.
After that I'll be able to add content :)

And again, thanks for playing my game! 
I love reading your comments and I really enjoy seeing what you all draw!

notes.title: Perfooormance
notes.content:
[b]Fixed the performance issue[/b]
Was definitely not something stupid that was executed waaaay too often :)

Also some small adjustments
[list]

[*] Achievements are now all unlockable
[*] Cursor is easier to edit
[*] Click cursor drawing should not reset anymore
[/list]
I just wanted to push the performance update as soon as possible as the later bunkers were just painful to play.

notes.title: Thanks!
notes.content: [p]Hey hey,[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for playing my game![/p][p][/p][p]I created this game as a solo dev in ~6 months for my final semester of school. It was supposed to be a small, finished game where you just have fun with friends and draw funny things.[/p][p]But I want to work more on the game. [/p][p][/p][p]You can expect quite a few changes over the next weeks, as I have many chaotic ideas that I want to implement. But the most important thing I've noticed is; the game is way too hard to understand and doesn't have a clear goal. That will be the very first thing I want to fix (after some bug fixing).[/p][p][/p][p]If you notice any bugs or have suggestions for improvement, you can share so in the pinned discussion. [/p][p][/p][p]And again, thank you all for the support. I hope we can create a fun and chaotic game![/p]
